Exemplar Devices Inc. Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

SPRINGFIELD, OHIO — Exemplar Devices Inc. today announced results for its second quarter of fiscal 2026, ended March 28, 2026.
Revenue$0.97 billion
Non-GAAP diluted EPS$1.02

Revenue was $0.97 billion, up 9 percent from the prior year, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $1.02.

Business Outlook

For the third quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company expects revenue of $0.98 billion to $1.02 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 60.5 percent, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.05 to $1.15.

For fiscal 2026, the Company expects revenue of approximately $4.0 billion and capital expenditures of approximately $150 million.

The Company expects its non-GAAP tax rate to be approximately 15 percent for fiscal 2026.

The Company anticipates continued strength in demand for its inspection products in the second half.

This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, including statements about revenue, gross margin and earnings per share that we expect for future periods.
